Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified “Brook Bar” as “The Brook” pub in Brooklands, Sale, instead of recognizing the historical “Brooks Bar” toll gate near Old Trafford. This incorrect assumption shifted the search to the wrong location and away from the area between the two historic toll gates (Brooks Bar and Trafford Bar), which would have led directly to Old Trafford and Manchester United.
